title: metais.test/1
description: What metais test prints with --json: every finding of the package's load and of each example, and as its result each example's status and differences, with what --update wrote and removed (ADR-007 D5, ADR-008 D9). The result is null when the run is refused: by a usage error, a package that cannot be read, or a failed write of --update.

examples.description: Each example run, in byte order of name: every example, or each one --example named. Empty when a template of the package did not parse, since no example then runs.

update.description: What --update wrote into and removed from the examples' expected/, or with --dry-run would; null without --update.

name.description: The example's name: its directory under examples/.

status.description: pass when the render equals expected/, or when --update made expected/ the render; fail when its example.yaml or inputs were refused, its render made an error, or a file differs; no-expected when it has no expected/ and so was rendered and not compared.

differences.description: Each path the comparison found different, in byte order of path; after --update, what the update changed.

path.description: The output's path, relative to expected/ and to the output directory.

kind.description: missing: in expected/ and not written by the render; unexpected: written and not in expected/; differs: in both, with other content.

line.description: For a text file that differs, the expected file's first differing line, from 1.

dry_run.description: Whether --dry-run was given, so that nothing was written or removed.

written.description: Each file written or replaced, as its path in the source directory, examples/<name>/expected/<path>, by example and then in path order.

removed.description: Each file removed because the render no longer writes it, as its path in the source directory, in the order removed. A directory of expected/ the removals emptied is removed too, and is not listed.
